description: One pay account: whether the address is one, its USDG, its owner, its top-up target and, with spender, that key's limits (per payment, per UTC day, expiry), what it spent today, what it has left and whether it is retired for good. Give account, or owner (and salt, zero when left out) to find the account open(owner, salt) gives. One read, kept 120 seconds.

owner.description: Instead of account: the owner's wallet; the account is found from it and salt.

salt.description: Optional, with owner: 32 bytes; zero when left out.

spender.description: Optional: a spender key's address, to read its limits and what it has left today.

name: pay_account
title: Mercatura Pay: read a pay account
